review_scope: Static mathematical/source review; no independent model, DGP, MonteCarlo or fixture execution in this pass

shape_review.bootstrap: same date weights and seed counts across all M; sqrt of resampled mean squared error per seed before seed averaging

P1_direction: For H0 theta<=delta, centered roots=theta_star-theta_hat and right-tail count roots>=theta_hat-delta is the basic-bootstrap boundary reference. Lower CI inversion agrees in direction; MonteCarlo discreteness and approximation remain.

P2_review.functional_derivative: (q-mu)/(2sqrt(mu)) per model and seed, paired difference
P2_review.seed_component: sample variance of individual-seed RMSE differences divided by S
P2_review.time_component: Bartlett HAC of seed-average influence divided by T
P2_review.interaction: reported separately; subtraction retained as diagnostic only
P2_review.conservative_label_condition: Only for the stated nondegenerate additive crossed-effects linearization with appropriate sampling/stationary dependence; not an exact finite-sample guarantee
P2_review.HLN: h=1 factor sqrt((T-1)/T); widening SE by inverse factor is algebraically equivalent to multiplying statistic
P2_review.reference_df: S-1 proposed conservative reference, distinct from a classical DM-HLN reference with temporal T-1; admissibility/calibration remain open

MCS_review.global_test: max absolute pairwise standardized RMSE functional difference
MCS_review.elimination: argmax over rows of maximal positive standardized loss difference

numeric_support_limit: 64eps*max(1,maxmu) and corresponding metric floors are not generally invariant to a change of physical units. A very small positive rescaling can move an otherwise supported grid into unsupported near-zero inference. Document this limit, do not tune after results.
settings_guard: Configured inference minimum cannot relax R10/T32; integer B and HAC lag checked.
